capabilities: read Bible text in a sidebar across four translations (개역한글, 개역개정, NIV, KJV)
jump to a chapter or verse via quick reference search with autocomplete (히3, 히3:5, Heb 3)
browse the Bible via Old/New Testament, book and chapter buttons
select multiple verses and copy them as callout or plain text with configurable formatting
load a user-supplied JSON file for the copyright-protected 개역개정 text
extras: The 개역개정 translation is copyright-protected and not bundled; users must place their own legally obtained JSON file in the vault and set its path. Other translations are fetched at runtime from bolls.life, so an internet connection is needed.
intentEvidence: 이 플러그인은 Janis Ringli님의 Bible Sidecar 플러그인을 포크해 한국어 환경에 맞게 재구성한 것입니다.
motivation: The author forked Janis Ringli's Bible Sidecar and reworked it to fit a Korean-language environment (Korean translations, Korean book names and abbreviations).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read Bible passages in a sidebar or copy verses into notes, especially in Korean translations.

relations.evidence: Janis Ringli님의 Bible Sidecar 플러그인을 포크해 한국어 환경에 맞게 재구성한 것입니다
개역한글 / NIV / KJV: bolls.life 공개 API에서 실시간으로 가져옵니다

summary: Sidebar Bible reader for Korean users with KRV, NKRV, NIV and KJV, quick reference search like 히3 or Heb 3, and verse copying.
